## Public-profile disclosure checklist

- [ ] No unreleased project/workstream/mission names or maturity/roadmap details.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, keys, passwords, cookies, or secret-bearing configuration.
- [ ] No private infrastructure, endpoints, account IDs, logs, or operational identifiers.
- [ ] No employer/client/vendor/partner confidential material.
- [ ] No unpublished invention/patent or restricted research details.
- [ ] Screenshots/documents checked for metadata, comments, URLs, filenames, IDs, and hidden content.
- [ ] Commit message and branch name are themselves safe to expose publicly.
- [ ] Third-party material is authorized/licensed.
- [ ] Classification reviewed: R0 / R1 / R2 / R3.
- [ ] Human public-release approval obtained.

**Default:** if uncertain, do not publish.
